We kick off an exciting new build! We'll drive, teardown, and media blast a 1974 Bronco to uncover what lies beneath 40+ years of abuse.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E10 — Building a Bronco
With the help of some master craftsmen, the guys start building a Bronco from the ground up, one that will cruise the beach, scream down the interstate and everything in between.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E13 — First Gen Bronco Gets a Modern Suspension
Our '74 Bronco build is getting a suspension overhaul plus new axles, brakes, wheels and tires! And John Kramer from Mecum Auctions stops by to check on the progress.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E10 — Mocking Up a New 1974 Bronco
It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E14 — The Beach Cruiser Bronco Gets Its Colors
We welcome custom car builder Chris Ryan and his team to help with our 1974 Bronco; we give it a professional paint job that will completely transform this build.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E15 — Adding Coyote Power to a Rebuilt Bronco
It's final assembly for our 1974 Bronco; we'll install a Coyote engine, roll bar and bed liner; a super smooth cut and buff on the new paint job.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E17 — '74 Bronco Chills With Aftermarket Air Conditioning
We wrap up the assembly of our Bronco as it gets a fuel system, exhaust, brakes, trim, gauges and new air conditioning.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S01 E18 — 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco Is Ready to Roll
Today we finish the final assembly of our 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco with the installation of the interior.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S02 E02 — Beach Cruiser Bronco Heads to Vegas
The guys work hard to finish the 1974 build before it's on its way to the SEMA Show.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
S02 E03 — Beach Cruiser Bronco Finale
The guys show off the completed 1974 Bronco on the floor at SEMA, then send it by truck to Mecum.

title: Music City Trucks
description:
Chevy DragAlanche: Part 1 -- Clean Slate Avalanche 202608AR
The team tears down a Chevy Avalanche to prep it for a dual-purpose performance build.

title: Under the Hood
description:
S01 E05 — Brad Starks - 1932 Coupe
Brad Starks' '32 Ford Coupe: a classic hot rod rebellion packing a supercharged LT4 with 680hp!

We're kicking off our newest build, a 1996 Chevy Tahoe; it's a 90s inspired sleeper show truck that you wished you drove in high school.

title: Blacktop Speed Shop
description:
1996 Tahoe Gets a Classy Chassis
Transforming vehicles with performance and styling upgrades.

description:

EBC Brakes gives away a 2020 F150, and wraps up with more upgrades; a trip to the Grand Ole Opry.

description:
S02 E19 — F150 Dream Truck Turbo Reloaded
We revisit our 2020 Ford F150 Dream Truck and add 200 rear wheel horsepower!

Building 2 identical 454 Big Block Chevys to run on the dyno at the same time.

description:

Connecting two 496 Big Block Chevy's to the dyno to find out how much power the same engines will make.

We seek more power from our twin-engine setup by reconfiguring the exhaust and phasing the engines.

We'll help you troubleshoot your F-150 with tips and tricks to keep your truck running reliably.

Prepping a big-block Ford to go in the big blue F-150; walking through the ins and outs of any and everything needed to plumb an entire fuel injection system from sump to solenoids.
